findings.description: A heading outside the selection records a substitution. bundle.shown_text and emitted_visible resolve every heading's withheld links through withholding_target with the mapping, which calls Substitution.redirect and marks the key served, whether or not the heading is selected. Reproduced at head: 'pf guide.md#main -m rules.md=stand-in.md', where rules.md is linked only by a deferred link in an unselected heading, reports W_MOCK_SUBSTITUTED with no location and no W_MOCK_UNUSED, and the bundle carries nothing of rules.md. Diagnostic accuracy only; the bundle is correct.

A substitute's own fragment-only section links are redirected again. closure.inside resolves a fragment-only link to the carrying document's path and then consults the mapping, so when the substitute's path is itself a key its '#section' links are redirected to that key's substitute. Reproduced at head: '-m rules.md=stand-in.md -m stand-in.md=other.md' turns stand-in.md's [detail](#detail) into a link to other.md#detail and bundles other.md. The design's no-chaining rule reads stand-in.md from disk but leaves its own section links exposed. E06 AC8 states that a substitute's fragment-only link resolves against that substitute.
